name: Nexus
description: Nexus - a simple, modular WhatsApp bot

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number, digits only with country code (e.g. 254712345678)

MODE.description: public (everyone can use commands) or private (owner only)

SESSION_ID.description: Session ID from your /pair page (starts with NEXUS~). Keep it secret.

CONNECT_ALERT.description: Send yourself a WhatsApp message when the bot connects (true/false)
